title: Art. 13.5 — Annex 6 - Operation of Aircraft, Part I - International Commercial Air Transport - Aeroplanes, Chapter 13 - Security, 13.5 Reporting acts of unlawful interference
content: Following an act of unlawful interference, the pilot- in- command shall submit, without delay, a report of such an act to the designated local authority.
